title: Marcus Aurelius' Rule To Never Get Angry
hook: Whenever you are offended by someone's lack of respect, ask yourself this one question.

scenes.text: Whenever you are offended by someone's lack of respect, ask yourself this one question.
scenes.visual_prompt: majestic roman emperor marcus aurelius marble bust, cinematic moody lighting, ancient pillars and storm clouds, 8k vertical masterpiece

scenes.text: Is it possible for shameless people not to exist in this world? Absolutely not.
scenes.visual_prompt: ancient roman colosseum during turbulent thunderstorm, dramatic cinematic lighting, hyperrealistic vertical composition

scenes.text: So why do you expect the impossible? You have encountered one of those inevitable fools.
scenes.visual_prompt: lone stoic warrior standing on a mountain cliff, violent wind, calm face, dramatic sunset lighting, photorealistic vertical

scenes.text: You cannot control the storm outside, but you have absolute power over your inner stillness.
scenes.visual_prompt: calm glowing bonsai tree inside a raging glass sphere amidst tempest, surreal hyperrealistic lighting, 8k vertical

scenes.text: Do not hand over the steering wheel of your emotions to people who cannot even control themselves.
